Daniel uses the plural for apocalyptic military forces casting down myriads (Dan 11:12). The dual ribbotayim in Psalm 68:18 means 'twice ten thousand' -- twenty thousand chariots of God. Spanish 'diez mil,' Arabic 'رَبْوَات,' and Korean '만' all render the concept."
